# canvas-confetti

`confetti-1.9.4.mjs` is the unmodified ES module distributed in the official npm package `canvas-confetti@1.9.4`.

Upstream: https://github.com/catdad/canvas-confetti
License: ISC, retained in `canvas-confetti.LICENSE`.
Package tarball SHA-1: `4412a5daa96afd0b4d70ecd66b65ce8db3022b2b`.

Hosted with the app so the celebration needs no runtime CDN request. Upgrade this pinned file explicitly when needed.
